text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Developers write unit tests to check small parts of code, and integration tests to make sure different parts work together. Many teams also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think clearly about what the code should do. Tests also give developers confidence. When they change or improve existing code, they can run the tests again to see if anything breaks. Without good tests, even a small change can cause serious problems. In short, testing saves time, reduces stress, and helps teams build better software.
